name: TS-Bench
description: TS-Bench is a standardized evaluation suite for assessing safety performance in Taiwanese Mandarin, covering critical domains such as financial fraud, medical misinformation, social discrimination, and political manipulation with 400 human-curated prompts.
reputation: A niche but relevant benchmark for Taiwanese Mandarin safety evaluation that is useful for regional model assessment, though it is not yet broadly adopted outside that community.
notes: Focuses on culturally grounded safety evaluation for Taiwanese Mandarin; used alongside Breeze Guard safety model.
